description: Power flux-density values from CEPT (ECC) documents that a satellite filing visible from Finland can be screened against. Only values read at the source are included, each with its page.

applicability.pfd_cept: A CEPT condition, not an RR limit. Crossing one is a concern for expert review; it does not by itself make a filing non-compliant with the Radio Regulations.

ECC/DEC/(25)02.doc: ECC Decision (25)02 on low power devices communicating with satellites (LPD-S) within the frequency range 862-870 MHz, approved 27 June 2025

transcription: Read from the text of the PDF above (Annex 1, printed page 5; Annex 2, printed page 6).

services: Space-to-Earth transmissions of satellites communicating with low power devices

citation.clause: Annex 1: "The PFD of space-to-Earth transmissions does not exceed -142 dB(W/(m².4kHz)) on the surface of the Earth within 862-870 MHz."

masks.note: The same at every angle of arrival: the Decision states it on the surface of the Earth. There is no satellite allocation in 862-870 MHz in CEPT countries (considering l), so satellites there operate under RR No. 4.4. Finland's implementation is planned (EFIS, 31-01-2027).

cept-dec2502-862-870.clause: Annex 2: satellite systems declaring compliance with the requirements of Annex 1

systems.commitment: C-TUR-25060153 dated 3 June 2025; C-TUR-25060408 dated 5 June 2025

not_covered.what: -146 dB(W/(m2.1MHz)) on the surface of the Earth outside 862-870 MHz, for the unwanted emissions of these transmissions
not_covered.why: IFIC filings do not describe unwanted emissions, so this can't be calculated.

not_covered.source: ECC Report 115 (January 2008), section 5 Conclusions, https://docdb.cept.org/download/474, sha256 7e902f20339054c33ea1b71925dd4590ab04eaa8e2df0ae8695c3fbe37550f34
not_covered.what: EESS spacecraft using non-directional antennas be designed to limit their spectral pfd on the Earth's surface to less than -123 dB(W/m2/MHz), corresponding to -147 dBW/m2 in 4 kHz, at their sub-satellite points
not_covered.why: A Report's mitigation to be considered, not a Decision, and it applies only to non-directional antennas and only at the sub-satellite point; the filing doesn't say whether an antenna is non-directional.

not_covered.source: ECC Report 373 (approved 13 February 2026), sections 3.3 and 4.2, https://docdb.cept.org/download/4910, sha256 1f154ca531d000c79082a663879e63682d2ef2a193cfbec9ccc1e4cf0774d36e
not_covered.what: pfd limits to protect terrestrial mobile networks from satellite direct-to-device downlinks in MFCN bands
not_covered.why: The Report says such limits "should be defined" and that "the actual future limits are still under study"; it gives no value of its own (its Table 2 repeats RR Appendix 5).
